title: phyllorkis alcicornis
intro: Phyllorkis alcicornis, commonly known as the "Ghost Orchid," is a rare and endangered orchid species found in the tropical forests of Sri Lanka. This plant is known for its unique, white, and hairless roots, which give it a ghostly appearance. Phyllorkis alcicornis has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Phyllorkis alcicornis include antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
